[attribute-supplement-type]
=== `@supplement-type` Type of Supplement

Type of supplement or the reason for the supplement (for example, “`conference`” for a supplement containing information from a conference or symposium).

#### Usage/Remarks
In NISO STS, this attribute is used only on citations and other referencing elements such as related articles. This is expected to be uncommon in standards documents.
#### Usage

The content of this element indicates the type of supplement or reason for the supplement (if the publisher has recorded that information), for example: issue for supplements to a particular journal issue conference for supplements containing information from a conference, symposium, or other gathering periodic for supplements issued at regular intervals topic for supplements concerning a particular subject area

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-supplement,`<supplement>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type or reason for the supplement, for example,
                        “`conference`” or
                        “`issue`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
